name: greenhouse-mcp
description: Greenhouse (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_greenhouse_board_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GREENHOUSE_BOARD_TOKEN
platform_mcp_greenhouse_board_token.description: The company's Greenhouse Job Board URL token, e.g. 'vaulttec' in https://boards.greenhouse.io/vaulttec.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Job Board API for ONE company's board (config board_token): GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs?content=true 'Returns the list of all job posts' — 'Job Board data is publicly available, so authentication is not required for any GET endpoints'. There are no keyword, location or paging parameters, so query/location/page/limit are not sent and every post comes back in one response (total = meta.total): filter client-side and do not request further pages. id is the job post id (use it with get_posting); content is the description as entity-encoded HTML; departments[], offices[], updated_at, application_deadline and metadata are in raw.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs/{job_id} 'Returns a job post'; pay_transparency=true adds pay_input_ranges[] when the employer publishes them. salary_min/salary_max are the FIRST range's min_cents/max_cents — amounts in cents, not units — and further ranges (e.g. per location) are in raw.pay_input_ranges.
